valor: Maikhuu es una de las pocas mujeres que conducen camiones en las rutas del carbón de Mongolia, en pleno auge minero. Atrapada en un convoy interminable rumbo a la frontera con China, cruza a diario el implacable desierto del Gobi y lucha por mantener a su familia. Su recorrido revela los costos humanos y ambientales de «Minegolia».

antes.midbo-2026: Maikhuu es una de las pocas mujeres que trabajan como conductoras de camiones en las rutas del carbón de Mongolia, en medio del auge minero que atraviesa el país. Día tras día, enfrenta la peligrosa tarea de transportar carbón a través del implacable desierto del Gobi. Atrapada en un convoy interminable de camiones con destino a la frontera con China, lucha por mantener a su familia, mientras su recorrido revela los costos humanos y ambientales de «Minegolia».

valor: Maikhuu is one of the few women driving trucks on Mongolia's coal routes, in the midst of a mining boom. Trapped in an endless convoy bound for the Chinese border, she crosses the relentless Gobi desert every day and struggles to support her family. Her journey reveals the human and environmental costs of "Minegolia".

antes.midbo-2026: Ever since its shift toward liberalism after the Cold War, Mongolia has opened up its mines in the Gobi desert for exploitation – resulting in an onslaught of truck convoys transporting Mongolian coal to China. Within this arduous, predominantly-male line of work, Maikhuu – a former taxi driver and hairdresser —– stands alone as one of the only female truck drivers working the mining boom.
antes.tribeca-2026: Maikhuu is one of the only female truck drivers hauling coal through Mongolia's Gobi desert during the country's mining boom. A single mother navigating severe droughts, deadly accidents, and relentless male competition.
